usedFor: karlia holds tasks, notes and suppliers, and Notion holds your workspace pages, so “New Task” can run “Create_Data_Source_Item”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in karlia, then “Create_Data_Source_Item” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Each new CRM task becomes an item in a Notion database, so the team sees it beside other work.

watchOut: “Update Supplier” in karlia fires when a supplier is updated, so the same supplier can create several Notion items.
